display.name: GCP Kubernetes Engine Overview
display.description: Overview of GCP Kubernetes Engine metrics

display.name: % Container Memory Limit Utilization
display.description: Non-evictable container memory as a fraction of its memory limit. Cannot exceed 100%; approaching 100% predicts an OOMKill.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_container' AND memory_type = 'non-evictable'

display.name: % PVC Volume Utilization
display.description: PersistentVolumeClaim fill level. Cannot exceed 100%. Alert above ~85% — a full volume takes the app down.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_pod'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_pod'

display.name: % Container CPU Limit Utilization
display.description: Container CPU usage as a fraction of its CPU limit. Can exceed 100% (bursting); sustained >100% indicates throttling.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_container'

display.name: % Container Memory Request Utilization
display.description: Non-evictable container memory as a fraction of its memory request. Guides right-sizing of memory requests.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_container' AND memory_type = 'non-evictable'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'

display.name: % Node CPU Allocatable Utilization
display.description: Node CPU usage as a fraction of allocatable CPU (excludes system daemons). High values indicate node saturation and scheduling pressure.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'

display.name: % Node Ephemeral Storage Utilization
display.description: Node ephemeral disk used / allocatable. Approaching 100% triggers DiskPressure -> eviction and image-pull failures.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_pod'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'
project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_container'

display.name: Node status conditions
display.description: Current Kubernetes node conditions (Ready / MemoryPressure / DiskPressure / PIDPressure / NetworkUnavailable).

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node' AND ((condition = 'Ready' AND status != 'True') OR (condition != 'Ready' AND status = 'True'))

display.name: % Container CPU Request Utilization
display.description: Container CPU usage as a fraction of its CPU request. Persistently <<100% = over-provisioned; >>100% = under-requested (scheduling/noisy-neighbor risk).

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_container'

display.name: % Node Memory Allocatable Utilization
display.description: Node memory usage as a fraction of allocatable memory (summed across components and memory types). Approaching 100% risks MemoryPressure and pod eviction.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_node'

display.name: Pod First-Ready Latency
display.description: End-to-end pod startup time (Created to Ready), including image pulls.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND cluster_name in $cluster_name AND namespace_name in $namespace_name AND gcp.resource_type = 'k8s_pod'
